captions.detailed: This is a 3D model of a bicycle hydraulic dropper seatpost. It features a dark grey or black outer lower tube, a silver anodized inner telescoping post, and a black upper assembly containing a saddle rail clamp. A thin black cable routes externally from the side of the upper clamp assembly downward, simulating a remote activation mechanism. The inner post telescopes smoothly along the vertical axis of the outer tube via a prismatic joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a bicycle hydraulic dropper seatpost with a prismatic joint. The lower part should be a dark grey outer tube, and the upper part should consist of a silver telescoping inner post capped with a black saddle rail clamp assembly and a side-routed activation cable.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube as a main bottom cylinder with a slightly wider collar cylinder at its top. Create the inner telescoping post from a smaller radius cylinder, and attach a box-based saddle clamp assembly at its top. Add a curved extrusion or swept path representing the side-routed cable, and define a prismatic joint between the outer tube and the inner post along the vertical Z-axis.
